# Nova Max Hospital

> Premier multi-specialty healthcare facility located in Digha, Patna, Bihar, specializing in Urology, Advanced Laparoscopy, Sexology, Male Infertility, Uro Gynecology, and General Surgeries.

Nova Max Hospital delivers expert clinical care under the direction of Dr. M. K. Sinha (Senior Consultant Urologist, ex-Sir J.J. Hospital Mumbai).

## Key Pages

- [Home Page](https://novamaxhospital.com/): Primary portal featuring department selection, doctor bios, and online appointment booking.
- [About Us](https://novamaxhospital.com/about): Hospital history, director credentials, and clinical infrastructure details.
- [Doctors](https://novamaxhospital.com/doctors): Complete roster of consulting specialists, medical credentials, and OPD schedules.
- [Hospital Departments](https://novamaxhospital.com/hospital-departments): Clinical departments providing specialized medical care.
- [Surgical Services](https://novamaxhospital.com/surgical-services): Advanced laparoscopic surgeries, keyhole procedures, and general surgical care.
- [Critical & Emergency Care](https://novamaxhospital.com/critical-care): 24/7 ICU, ICCU, hemodialysis unit, and emergency trauma management.
- [Facilities & Diagnostics](https://novamaxhospital.com/facilities-diagnostics): Digital X-Ray, ultrasound, and in-house pathology laboratory.
- [Book Appointment](https://novamaxhospital.com/book-appointment): Digital booking form for OPD consultations and surgical evaluations.
- [Contact Us](https://novamaxhospital.com/contact): Hospital address, interactive map, emergency telephone numbers, and inquiry desk.

## Core Medical Specialties

- [Urology](https://novamaxhospital.com/services/urology): Treatment for kidney stones (RIRS laser, PCNL, URS), enlarged prostate (TURP), UTIs, and bladder diseases.
- [Laparoscopic Surgery](https://novamaxhospital.com/services/laparoscopy): Keyhole surgeries including Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy (Gallstones), Hernia repair (TEP/TAPP), Appendectomy, and Hysterectomy.
- [Male Infertility](https://novamaxhospital.com/services/male-infertility): Semen analysis, hormonal evaluations, and varicocele micro-surgery.
- [Sexology](https://novamaxhospital.com/services/sexology): Confidential consultations and treatments for Erectile Dysfunction (ED) and Premature Ejaculation (PE).
- [Uro Gynecology](https://novamaxhospital.com/services/uro-gynecology): Female urinary incontinence, pelvic floor repair, and gynecological procedures.
